resources.remote_code_release_archive_reason: Release transport artifact is separate from method data payload and is not measured by this evaluator
resources.unmeasured_reason: CPU only; no deployment package/transfer measured; RSS null if runtime unavailable; objective wall times include their measured forward or cached backward work; standalone kernel timing is not measured
resources.fitted_state_scope: Unique numeric buffers for U/V0, raw support, labels, geometry, q, residual alpha/centers and actual B prior; training caches, archived arrays and frozen Phase1 are separate from resident deployment state
resources.interpretation: Stage duration sums measure work, not concurrent elapsed time. Shared preparation is charged once. Final scoring timings are measured on the stated CPU/thread configuration.
